summary: BUG-206 v2 fix VERIFIED WORKING. Merging foodId enrichment INTO normaliseRecipe(r, foods) + adding foodsMaster to hydration useEffect deps fully resolves the reverse-lookup issue. V9 Batch Save: PUT /recipe/update-recipe/4874 with payload {"name":168408,"preparation_time":"55",...} → 200 OK. RT-1 Round-Trip: After page reload, prep persisted as 55. Reverted prep back to 10 (200 OK) to leave preprod clean. REGRESSION Add Recipe food picker: 98 options rendered correctly for new rows. All 3 test scenarios PASS.

issues: No success toast or submit-results banner appears after successful save. Reason: handleSave() calls onRefresh?.() which triggers parent re-fetch → new recipes prop → hydration useEffect fires setSubmitResults(null), clearing the banner. Toasts also seem to be dismissed/missing. Minor UX regression — user gets no visual confirmation that save succeeded (they see the updated value in the row though). Not blocking; server save succeeds correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX POLISH (non-blocking): After successful bulk save, the success toast / submit-results banner is not visible because onRefresh?.() causes parent to re-pass recipes prop → hydration useEffect resets submitResults=null. Consider either (a) preserving the banner state across recipe prop updates, or (b) not calling onRefresh when all saves succeeded (data is already fresh from server response), or (c) using a slightly longer toast duration. User currently gets no visual confirmation despite the save succeeding on the server.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L34-49 (BUG-206 v2 fix): The merged normaliseRecipe(r, foods) approach is CORRECT and works reliably. Enrichment happens at row construction time, so no effect ordering issues. Verified via network trace: PUT payload has name:168408 (integer food_id) instead of null.

RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L82-86 hydration useEffect deps [recipes, recipeType, foodsMaster]: CORRECT. When foodsMaster loads async (after recipes), useEffect re-runs and re-hydrates rows with enriched foodId. Verified live: rows[4874].foodId = '168408' after ~7-9s wait (foodsMaster load latency).

MINOR: L82-86 hydration useEffect always calls setSubmitResults(null). This is why the success banner disappears after onRefresh triggers a re-hydration. Consider preserving submitResults if only foodsMaster ref changed (guard against clearing on foods-only refresh).

MINOR: onRefresh?.() (L227, 232) is called after successful saves, which refetches ALL recipes from parent. Since the server response already contains the updated recipe, an optimistic-update approach would avoid the full re-fetch and keep the success banner visible. Not blocking.

rca of the issue: BUG-206 root cause was React effect ordering. Previous v1 fix used a separate useEffect for reverse-lookup with deps=[foodsMaster], which failed when hydration useEffect (deps=[recipes, recipeType]) re-ran and reset rows to foodId=null but foodsMaster ref hadn't changed → the reverse-lookup didn't re-fire. V2 fix merges the enrichment INTO normaliseRecipe(r, foods) at row construction time and adds foodsMaster to hydration deps → atomic and correct. Verified live: PUT body now sends name:168408 (food_id integer) instead of name:null → server accepts with 200 OK.
